Proactive and autodidact while learning new technologies

Team player - One for all and all for one!

responsibilities.head: Working as a Senior Software Engineer at Appfire through Sngular, contributing to Connector for Salesforce & Jira, an enterprise integration application enabling bidirectional synchronization between Atlassian Jira and Salesforce.
elements: Drive architectural improvements across legacy and modern services, focusing on scalability, maintainability, and reliability.
Modernized the technology stack from Java 8 to Java 11, enabling adoption of newer Scala versions.
Designed a data residency migration architecture for Atlassian Cloud, prioritizing idempotency, fault tolerance, and resilience.
Investigated and resolved critical JVM memory issues through heap-dump analysis, memory tuning, and AWS infrastructure optimization.
Collaborate with Tier-2 support to troubleshoot production incidents and resolve complex customer escalations.
Maintain compatibility with evolving Atlassian and Salesforce APIs and platform requirements.
Improve technical analysis, implementation planning, code reviews, and test design with AI-assisted development workflows and MCP integrations.
Enhanced CI/CD pipelines with automated AI-assisted pull-request reviews while maintaining existing quality gates and engineering standards.

responsibilities.head: Worked on Sonata DSP, a high-performance AdTech platform:
elements: Designed and developed scalable backend services using Java and Node.js.
Maintained a distributed microservices architecture with a focus on performance and reliability.
Owned features end to end, from design through deployment.
Worked closely with Product, DevOps, and Data Science teams.
Used Elasticsearch, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, and AWS services including ECS, EC2, and S3.
Worked in an Agile Scrum environment with a strong focus on code quality and automated testing.

responsibilities.head: Integration of company's biometric solutions to web platforms:
elements: Creation and maintenance of Web SDKs implementing native libraries (Javascript, Typescript, WASM)
Demo Apps implementing those SDKs for potential customers (Angular, Vue.js)
Support to customer when integrating our solutions on their projects
Integration of native libraries in backend server (Java 11, Spring Boot, JNI, C++)

responsibilities.head: Also, using my previous experience, some tasks in CI/CD flow:
elements: Design of a full pipeline for each of the web-related repositories
Helping in choosing the tools and architecture to be used (AWS)

responsibilities.head: Platform Team - Software Engineer:
elements: Worked with Java 11, Spring Framework, Hibernate, ActiveMQ, and Oracle DB; managed CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins.
Maintained code quality using Selenium, integration tests, FitNesse, Postman, and SonarQube.
Designed, developed, and maintained public SOAP and REST APIs.
Built and supported interfaces and connectors to external systems.
Provided direct technical support to external integrators using the APIs.
Followed Agile Scrum practices using Jira and applied TDD with JUnit and Mockito.
Led the migration of external connectors from a monolith to a microservices architecture.

responsibilities.head: Ruby on Rails developer at NGA Human Resources, developing the Payroll Exchange application.
elements: Worked across backend and frontend using MongoDB, MySQL, jQuery, Bootstrap, HAML, CoffeeScript, Angular, Sass, JavaScript, and Ruby on Rails.
Followed TDD with RSpec and used Docker for application maintenance.

responsibilities.head: SAP Technical Consultant, specialized in Talent Management modules:
elements: Specialized in Performance, e-Recruitment, Learning, Organizational Management, and Personnel Administration.
Developed customer-facing JavaScript and jQuery features and SAP HCM backend functionality with ABAP.
Developed web applications for Spanish data-protection compliance using JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, PHP, MySQL, and Bootstrap.
Worked on SEO and community-management tasks.
